cat > /workdir/analyze.py <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time,json
import arena
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM);s.settimeout(600);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(a): s.sendall((a+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
for l in f:
 if l.strip()=='uciok':break
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256');send('isready')
for l in f:
 if l.strip()=='readyok': break
b=arena.load_board()
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1])*1000) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 30000))
last=''
for l in f:
 l=l.strip()
 if l.startswith('info depth'):last=l
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):
  print(last,flush=True);print(l,flush=True)
  open('/workdir/analysis.json','w').write(json.dumps({'fen':b.fen(),'info':last,'bestmove':l.split()[1]}))
  break
send('quit')
